caption:
You're holding your breath. But the relief you keep waiting for was meant to be breathed out — not held in. (John 20:21-22 devotional)

You've been guarding peace like a treasure to keep, holding your breath for a relief that never comes. But Jesus breathed on them — the same word used only once before, when God breathed life into Adam — and the peace born from His pierced side was never meant to be sealed in; it was meant to pour out. In Christ that peace is already yours, not a state to store but a gift to breathe into a world of broken bonds.
